description: Runs a query and stores the result in the cache without returning it or throwing. Used on the server before rendering.
Turns a `QueryClient` cache into a plain serializable object (keys, data, timestamps) that travels with the HTML.
Component that writes a dehydrated state into the nearest `QueryClient` during render, so the first client render has the server data. `hydrate(client, state)` is the non-React equivalent.
On the server a new client is created for every request; a shared one leaks data between users and grows forever.
Hydrated data keeps the server timestamp. With `staleTime: 0` it is stale on arrival and refetched on mount; a non-zero `staleTime` avoids the double fetch.
